subject: BrightPath annual commitment — staggered invoices, Net90 request, and credit guardrails
messages:
From: Marcus Lee <marcus@brightpath.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Procurement <procurement@brightpath.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Annual commitment discussion: 3yr term, partial upfront & Net90 ask

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightPath is excited about Redwood — the throughput and cost profile match our product roadmap. We’re evaluating a 3-year committed relationship (enterprise plan) and have two key asks that will determine how quickly we can sign:

1) Pricing/Discounts: We’d prefer an annual prepay for pricing simplicity. If we prepay annually for a 3-year term, what tiered discount can you offer?

2) Payment terms / invoicing: Procurement is requesting flexibility on payments. Due to internal budgeting cycles we need: 50% upfront at contract signature, and the remaining 50% to be invoiced in two milestone tranches (end of Q2 and end of Q4 each year) on Net90 terms.

We know Net90 on milestone invoices is not standard. We’re prepared to provide a stronger financial guarantee (letter of credit or an escrow clause) if necessary. Attached is a draft SOW and a high-level procurement note.

Can you outline options today so we can take to our CFO? We’re hoping to close in the next 3–4 weeks.

Thanks,
Marcus Lee
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightPath Analytics
Attachments: BrightPath_SOW_v1.pdf, procurement-note.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus@brightpath.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@brightpath.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual commitment discussion: 3yr term, partial upfront & Net90 ask

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear ask and the SOW. Quick read-through was helpful. We can offer two commercial options that map to your billing preference. High level: both options assume the 3-year term and include the performance SLAs from the catalog.

Option A — Annual prepay (full year up front):
- Discount: 18% off list for a 3-year annual prepay commitment
- Invoicing: single annual invoice per year, due Net30
- No Net90 available for fully prepaid invoices

Option B — Split prepay + milestone tranches (closer to your request):
- Discount: 12% off list if 50% paid at signature and 50% invoiced in two tranches per year
- Tranche invoices can carry Net90, subject to Finance approval and an agreed credit guardrail (letter of credit or escrow for Year 1 deposits equivalent to one tranche)
- Redwood will require an internal approval flow for Net90 on milestone invoices; this typically takes 3–5 business days.

If you need Net90 across all invoices without an escrow mechanism, we will need to offset with a lower discount (e.g., 8%).

Next steps: I’ll loop in Finance to request a Net90 exception for Option B and attach our recommended guardrail language. Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether your CFO will accept an escrow/LOC for Year 1?

Also attaching our standard redline of terms (key points highlighted).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_terms_redline_v1.docx
From: Marcus Lee <marcus@brightpath.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@brightpath.com>, BrightPath Procurement <procurement@brightpath.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual commitment discussion: 3yr term, partial upfront & Net90 ask

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear options. We’d like to proceed with Option B (50% upfront / 50% tranche) at 12% discount, provided Finance signs off on Net90 for the milestone invoices. BrightPath is willing to put an escrow equal to one tranche (12 months of usage) for Year 1 while Net90 is phased in. If Year 1 billing performance is clean, we’d like the escrow to be released and Net90 to continue for Year 2–3.

Can Redwood confirm:
- What exact guardrail language does Finance need?
- Who is the internal approver for Net90 exceptions and how long will that take to get final sign-off?

We can route the SOW and your redlines to our legal today once we have the commercial terms in email.

Regards,
Marcus

On procurement-note.pdf: see comments about invoice routing and tax details.
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightPath annual commitment — Net90 exception request (need approvals)

Folks — forwarding BrightPath’s confirmation that they’ll take Option B at 12% with an escrow for Year 1. Ask: Finance approval needed for Net90 on milestone invoices with an escrow release clause after Year 1.

Summary of proposal:
- 3-year term, annual billing split into: 50% due at signature (Invoice 1), remaining 50% split into two milestone invoices per year (Invoice 2 at end of Q2, Invoice 3 at end of Q4)
- Discount 12% off list with escrow equal to one tranche for Year 1; escrow released after Year 1 provided timely payment history
- Milestone invoices: Net90 (Finance exception required)

Specific asks:
- Ben: please confirm commercial approval for 12% discount + Net90 exception path and sign-off authority (or escalate to Sales Ops leadership).
- Dylan: ops question — can billing support the tranche schedule and a Year-1 escrow release workflow? If yes, detail what documentation we’ll need on the front end.

I’ve attached the latest contract redline (BrightPath_Redline_terms_v3.docx) with a suggested escrow clause and release conditions in Section 8.

Thanks — would like approvals before EOD Monday so we can send legal-ready terms to BrightPath.

—Stephanie
Senior Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachments: BrightPath_Redline_terms_v3.docx, BrightPath_SOW_v1.pdf, Invoice_1_50pct_upfront.pdf
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus@brightpath.com>, Asha Rao <asha@brightpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Commercial terms for BrightPath 3yr commitment + next steps (DocuSign link)

Marcus / Asha —

Thanks for the patience while we routed approvals. Finance has confirmed a Net90 exception for milestone invoices under the following guardrails:

- Commercial: 12% discount for the 3-year commitment with 50% upfront and 50% invoiced in two tranches per year.
- Credit guardrail: escrow equal to one tranche for Year 1; escrow release after 12 months of on-time milestone payments (no late payments >15 days).
- If payment performance falls below the threshold, Redwood reserves the right to: require prepayment for the next 12 months, suspend Net90 privileges, or apply a liquidity hold to future invoices.
- Ops: Billing confirms the tranche invoice schedule and will issue Invoice 1 at signature (50% upfront). Invoice 2 and Invoice 3 will be generated per the SOW milestones and flagged as Net90.

Attached: final contract redline (BrightPath_Redline_terms_v3.docx) and the Year-1 invoice stub (Invoice_1_50pct_upfront.pdf). Please review; I’ve included a DocuSign link for the signature-ready agreement. If you sign by next Wednesday we can target a Dec 1 start date and reserve the committed capacity.

DocuSign (signature link): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7821

If you’d like a quick call to walk legal through the escrow clause, I’m available tomorrow 9–11am PT.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
